title: asthenatherum glaucum var. lasiophyllum
intro: Asthenatherum glaucum var. lasiophyllum, commonly known as Lasiophora, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. It is a type of grass known for its various uses in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lasiophora include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Lasiophora include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
